nodes.description: Select a newline-delimited text entry using a numeric field. characters=true instead selects Unicode scalar characters (not shaped glyphs or grapheme clusters). Index is floored, then wrapped when loop=true or clamped otherwise. Connect Time/Expression/Keyframes to index and a published Text control to text; Text shapes the selected entry with its embedded font. Empty entries produce empty text.

catalog.notes: Examples describe operation arguments. Optional group selects an internal graph. node merges inputs, settings, position and fold.motion.animation; id/kind/version stay stable. group merges a typed GroupDefinition; inputs have stable id, name, kind, default, unit, section, advanced. Inspect existing groups for complete examples. extract preserves the node ID as an instance; inspect that node settings.group to find its generated definition ID. Resources are omitted from inspection. All edits validate together. Datum is externally tagged: Scalar, Vector, Color, Bool, Text.

query_notes.evaluated: Defaults to the scene. Optionally select object UUID, or node UUID plus output socket; object and node are exclusive. Supported fields are counts, elements and bounds; limit is 1..200. Bounds measure outlines/points, excluding stroke, effects and clipping. Pixel visibility requires rendered evidence. Unknown fields are errors.

verification.control_response: control is a Published Control node; values contains two tagged Datum values. Evaluates both on private clones, with no project mutation. Bounded geometric/paint or uniform-field change is sampled evidence; intended magnitude and pixel visibility need separate checks.
verification.relative_position: relative_to is another object or node/output target; relation left/right/above/below compares outline edges, offset compares centers to expected [dx,dy] at every sampled time

wrangle.notes: Source is a Rust function body. No macros, attributes, modules, imports, static state or external dependencies. Channels require literal names. wrangle synchronizes controls and compiles before commit. Existing unused controls are preserved.
